source: published check value, plus derivations from the generator and preset
note: CRC-16-CCITT as CCSDS uses it for frame and packet error control: generator 0x1021, preset all ones, most-significant bit first, no reflection and no final inversion. A scalar result is written as hex at its natural width, big-endian, which is also the order the field takes on the wire.

encode.name: check-value-123456789
encode.note: The standard check value for this CRC: the ASCII string "123456789" gives 0x29b1. Published for CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE.

encode.name: empty-input-returns-the-preset
encode.note: With no data the register is never clocked, so the result is the preset itself, 0xffff. Follows directly from the all-ones preset.

encode.name: single-zero-octet
encode.note: One zero octet against the all-ones preset gives 0xe1f0. Clocking the register eight times from 0xffff with generator 0x1021 produces it.

encode.name: single-ff-octet
encode.note: One 0xff octet clears the top byte of the all-ones preset before clocking, giving 0xff00.
